name: node
description: Node.js JavaScript Runtime - Server-side JavaScript execution environment with npm package manager

node.description: Node.js JavaScript runtime for executing server-side applications with V8 engine

npm.description: Node Package Manager for installing and managing JavaScript packages
npm.usage: npm install package | npm run script | npm audit --fix

npx.description: Node Package Execute - run packages without installing globally
npx.usage: npx create-react-app my-app | npx cowsay hello | npx eslint .

corepack.description: Package manager manager - enables yarn/pnpm without separate installation
corepack.usage: corepack enable | corepack prepare yarn@stable --activate | corepack use pnpm
